intent_contract.text: y2k，我的世界游戏，情绪 프롬프트 작성해줘.

A photographic scene combining turn-of-the-millennium Y2K styling, the Minecraft game, and an emotionally expressive atmosphere. Wistful late-night gaming is the authored realization of the open emotional direction.

An intimate photographic portrait of an adult woman taking a quiet break from Minecraft in a small bedroom after midnight. Minecraft runs on a desktop monitor, showing pixel-textured grass blocks, cubic trees, a square sun near the horizon, and a small player-built house with glowing windows. She sits in a desk chair facing the screen, both feet resting on the floor, her right forearm supported by the desk and her right hand resting on the mouse; her left hand lies loosely beside the keyboard. Her eyes linger on the little house, her shoulders soften, and a tired half-smile makes the moment feel bittersweet, as though this digital place holds a private memory. Y2K styling appears in a silver satin camisole over a fitted white baby tee, baggy blue jeans, tiny butterfly hair clips, and wired translucent headphones resting around her neck. A closed flip phone and a few loose CDs catch light beside the keyboard. Cool monitor light meets a small pink bedside lamp, illuminating natural skin texture and the folds of her clothes. A three-quarter side view keeps her face, both hands, and the readable game scene together, with the room falling into gentle shadow. The photograph carries the intimate, slightly grainy texture of a compact-camera diary snapshot.
